title: Sampling of Tooth Roots for Ancient DNA
author: Marcel Keller
materials: Wipe down markers and pens with DNA Exitus.
For the next sample, start from step 9.

steps.title: Prepare Drill Hood and Work Area
steps.instruction: Set up the drill hood to prevent contamination and contain dust.

substeps.instruction: Cover the entire surface of the drill hood with aluminum foil.
Create an L-shaped wall of folded foil along the back and the side without the drill to contain flying dust.
Place a smaller piece of foil on the working surface.
Place a large weighing boat onto the working surface.
Clean the drill hood and table bench surfaces with DNA Exitus and wipe clean with a paper towel.
Turn the hood on full power and open the glass.

steps.title: Set Up Decontamination Station
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary solutions for tool decontamination using four disposable 100 ml beakers.

substeps.instruction: Prepare two aliquots of 6% NaOCl (bleach).
Prepare one aliquot of MilliQ water.
Prepare one aliquot of 70% ethanol.

steps.title: Decontaminate Tools
steps.instruction: Clean all drilling and sampling tools before use.

substeps.instruction: Soak drill bits, drill spanner, tweezers, dental scalers, and toothbrushes in 6% bleach for 5 minutes.
Rinse tools with MilliQ water, then rinse with 70% Ethanol.
Clean the drill spanner and tooth extractors with DNA Exitus.

steps.title: Prepare Sampling Materials
steps.instruction: Label and organize bags and tubes to limit contamination.

substeps.instruction: Label bags for drilled samples with Sample ID, Date, and Initials.
Label tubes (e.g., for calculus) with Top Side, Content, Project ID, Sample ID, Date, and Initials.
Keep tubes closed immediately after removing from packaging and open only during sampling.

steps.title: Personal Protective Equipment and Drill Setup
steps.instruction: Equip yourself and configure the drill for operation.

substeps.instruction: Put on clean sleeves (pushing thumbs through plastic close to cuffs) and then put gloves on top.
Ensure the drill bit/wheel is centered and firmly seated in the drill.
Turn the drill to 'FWD' mode and select a medium speed to prevent overheating or burning of bone/dentine.
Ensure your foot is off the pedal when not intending to drill.

steps.title: Sample Loading
steps.instruction: Move samples into the protected environment.

substeps.instruction: Place the sample bag, clean sample bag, and tube into the hood behind the foil wall.
Perform all work as far into the hood as possible and keep eyes behind the glass for protection.

steps.title: Remove Calculus (If Applicable)
steps.instruction: Extract calculus from the tooth before drilling.

substeps.instruction: Place the tooth into a mini grip bag and hold the tooth outside the bag with fingers.
Use a dental scaler to gently push and collect all calculus inside the bag.
Remove the tooth and pour the calculus onto weighing paper.
Transfer calculus into a labeled 1.5 ml tube after taring.

steps.title: Drill Tooth Root
steps.instruction: Extract powder from the tooth root.

substeps.instruction: Wrap foil strips around the ends of the tooth extractor.
Hold the tooth with the tooth extractor.
Carefully drill a few millimeters above the end of the root.

steps.title: Collect and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Secure the drilled samples and clean the exterior of the containers.

substeps.instruction: Place samples in labeled bags.
Wipe the bags with a small amount of DNA Exitus before adding them to the sample box.

steps.title: Immediate Tool and Area Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean the drill and dispose of single-use materials between samples.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the drill wheel with MilliQ water, then soak in 6% bleach for a few minutes (or while drilling the next tooth).
Rinse the wheel with water, then ethanol, and dry before reuse.
Remove and discard the weighing boat, small work surface foil, dirty gloves, and sleeves.
Put on new gloves.

steps.title: Final Daily Shutdown
steps.instruction: Perform a complete cleanup of the workstation at the end of the day.

substeps.instruction: Wipe down tooth extractors and drill spanner with DNA Exitus and put them away.
Use a clean toothbrush with a little DNA Exitus to remove sample powder from the top/inside of the drill head (do not use bleach to avoid rusting inner components).
Soak drill bits and scalers in bleach.
Discard all foil and other consumables.
Wipe down all inner hood work surfaces and the outside of the drill with DNA Exitus and wipe dry with paper towels.
